flute.name: Flute
flute.register: Low register (C4-A4): breathy, intimate. High: bright, birdlike

oboe.name: Oboe
oboe.register: Middle register solos; paired with English horn for warmth

english_horn.name: English horn
english_horn.register: Used for specific emotional color — distance, nostalgia

clarinet.name: Clarinet
clarinet.register: Chalumeau register (low): dark warmth. High: bright singing

bassoon.name: Bassoon
bassoon.function: Low wind color; sardonic or pastoral
bassoon.register: Not comic (as in Mozart); atmospheric, adding depth

horn.name: Horn
horn.register: Muted horns for veiled color; open horns for noble distance

trumpet.name: Trumpet
trumpet.register: Muted: delicate. Open: only at genuine climaxes

trombone.name: Trombone
trombone.function: Very rare; archaic or dramatic weight

timpani.name: Timpani
timpani.function: Rumble, distant thunder; not rhythmic drive

violin_i_(div.).name: Violin I (div.)
violin_i_(div.).register: Divided into 3-4 parts; high tremolo; muted for distant quality

violin_ii_(div.).name: Violin II (div.)
violin_ii_(div.).function: Inner texture, independent of Vln I
violin_ii_(div.).register: Not merely doubling Vln I — distinct harmonic layer

viola_(div.).name: Viola (div.)
viola_(div.).register: Divided for rich inner texture; sometimes melodic

cello_(div.).name: Cello (div.)
cello_(div.).register: Solo cello for intimate melody; divided for warmth

double_bass.name: Double bass
double_bass.register: Rarely busy; sustained pedals, pizzicato punctuation
